title: Round Face Shape: Identification Guide & AI Check
summary: How to tell if you have a round face shape: defining traits, round vs. oval vs. square differences, fuller cheek confusion, and an instant 3-step check.
body_markdown:
### What is a round face shape?


A face where length and cheekbone width are nearly equal, cheekbones are the widest point, and the jawline and chin are softly rounded rather than angular.


### How do I know if my face is round or oval?


Compare length to width: oval reads clearly longer than wide; round reads close to equal. Both share curved lines, so proportions are the deciding factor.


### Does weight gain make my face "round"?


Weight alters cheek volume, not structural proportions like the forehead-to-jaw width relationship. Fuller cheeks can make any shape feel rounder without changing the shape itself—identify by proportions, not fullness.


### How accurate is face-shape detection from a photo?


A detector applies the same ratio logic as a manual measurement—consistently and instantly. Best results come from a front-facing, well-lit photo with hair pulled back and a neutral expression.
